description: Reactivate after kill_switch. Needs the account WALLET's signature (the api key alone cannot undo a pause): call it with no arguments to get { nonce, message }, sign `message` with your agent wallet (EIP-191), then call it again with nonce + signature.

nonce.description: Second call only: the nonce returned by the first call

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of the challenge message, by the account wallet

name: resume_trading
